title: Council_Districts
description: PURPOSE - Phoenix council district boundaries, council members and council district outlines are shown for use either individually or together in any combination to provide the best readability when used with different basemaps or aerial photos. SOURCE - Phoenix city ordinances, dedications, surveys.
snippet: This map provides City of Phoenix boundaries, boundary outlines and council member information.

title: Eviction Filings by Council Districts
description: The 8 Council Districts of the City of Phoenix. This dataset is a copy of the authoritative Council Districts feature class, with an additional column indicating the number of eviction filings within each district. The number of eviction filings is carried over from the Eviction Filings point feature class, which consists of the geocoded addresses of defendants in eviction filings within the Phoenix city limits. The Maricopa County Justice Courts (MCJC) originally provides this data as a spreadsheet which lists all eviction filings within Maricopa County. Currently this feature class reflects eviction filings in the Phoenix city limits as of August 2025 and should be regularly updated as MCJC updates their eviction filing reports.
snippet: Eviction filings by City of Phoenix Council District.
